name: Samurott

abilities.name: Stance
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent’s next turn.

attacks.name: Pike
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.

flavor:
Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do
not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

pokedex.text: NO. 0503 Formidable Pokémon HT: 4'11" WT: 208.6 lbs.
